$comment: Tag registry (design doc §6, §7.19). Sheet HP/ATK/DEF/Speed already include flat armor and load effects; armorSource.defBonus records how much of the sheet DEF is armor for armor_piercing to reduce, it is NOT added again. Conditional entries are evaluated per attack by the engine.

tags.summary: Conscript or obligation-based muster rather than professional troops.
Every morale hit lands harder; nearby allies routing shakes them further.
Farm tools: ATK x0.7 against anyone with real armor; full ATK against unarmored targets.
tags.note: Farm tools hit fine against soft targets, poorly against anyone with real armor or formation discipline.

tags.summary: Quilted cloth, the cheapest real armor tier. 3 points of sheet DEF are armor-sourced.
tags.note: Helps against cuts, does little against a solid thrust or a charge. armor_piercing halves the armor-sourced portion.

tags.summary: Trained spear work. Unlocks the hold_formation order (DEF +2 while held).
2 points of sheet DEF are shield-sourced; +1 more DEF specifically against ranged attacks.
Cavalry. ATK x1.3 against routing enemies; leaving a fighting cell costs half.
ATK x1.4 on the first round of a new melee engagement (charge); morale -15 if the charge is stopped. Requires Speed >= 4.
Mail hauberk. 5 points of sheet DEF are armor-sourced; the Speed -1 is already priced into the sheet.
Base flag for any unit with Range >= 1. Fires at a chosen target within its Range each round.
ATK x0.4, DEF x0.5 once engaged in melee.
Second volley each round against a fire target with Speed <= 2.
Volley charges for the whole battle (24 arrows default, 12 javelins via tagParams). On depletion loses skirmish_volley and gains low_melee.
tags.note: Represents a full quiver; essentially never depletes within a single battle. Real depletion risk lives at the campaign/logistics layer.

tags.summary: Ignores 50% of the target's armor-sourced DEF.
Fires only every 2nd round.
Unlocks skirmish_and_withdraw (fire, then leave at half disengage cost, no return strike that round). Requires Range >= 1 and Speed >= 3.
ATK x0.6, DEF x0.7 once engaged in melee; better than low_melee, still weak.
Against routing enemies: damage x1.5 with the sidearm and no ammo spent.
DEF x1.8 against mounted attackers; counter-damage against a mounted charge.
Morale shock -10 on hit against units without gunpowder_exposed.
Has faced gunpowder before; immune to loud.
Universal: morale_damage_ratio x0.6, HP x1.05, ATK x1.05. Earned by surviving a battle while Engaged at least once.
Bypasses hardened_structure against Fortification Points. Against troops HP damage is halved but morale damage uses the unhalved value.
ATK x1.2 for the rest of the battle the first time the unit receives Address the Troops or a Rally.
tags.note: Not a default on any sheet; carried only by units the narrative flags as berserkers.

tags.summary: Structure counts as a Wooden Fortification Point for defence; the +10 is already in the sheet DEF and is armor-sourced.
Speed 0 for movement, but still receives 1 action point per round usable only for firing.
Fires only every 3rd round.
Damage roll multiplier randomised 0.7-1.1 on each shot.
Cancels siege_weapon's HP halving against troops; still bypasses hardened_structure.
While engaged against a Fortification Point, negates its Defender DEF Bonus for the duration.
Per-shot choice: solid shot (siege_weapon behaviour) or grapeshot (precision_bolt behaviour, no structure bypass).
12% chance per shot to deal its own rolled damage to itself instead of the target. Early Cannon only.
